description: One change the person made to their location history, such as renaming a place, moving a visit to another place or deleting a journey.

main.description: One change the person made to their location history, such as renaming a place, moving a visit to another place or deleting a journey. Corrections are stored separately from the samples, so working the history out again never loses them. A correction is never edited: a later one replaces it by listing it in supersedes. The current corrections to a field of one thing are the ones no other correction lists in supersedes. If they all give the same value, that value applies. If they disagree, none of them applies, the thing keeps its own value, and the person is offered the disagreeing corrections as a conflict to settle. A delete correction applies as soon as one exists. Corrections are never ordered by time, because many have no createdAt.

evidenceId.description: What the correction applies to. A visit or journey that LogDate worked out is named by the id of one of its location samples (an app.logdate.place.sample point id); a visit the person added, by its app.logdate.place.visit record key; a place, by place: followed by its app.logdate.place.place record key; and a journey LogDate inferred between two visits, by derived:journey: followed by the owner, the device and the ids of the samples it runs between, separated by colons.

field.description: What the correction changes. label: the name shown (set label); for a place, an agreed label also marks the place as confirmed. place: which place a visit, or a place merged into another, belongs to (set place). activity: how the person traveled (set activity). start and end: when it began or ended (set startsAt or endsAt). delete: removes it from the history, and needs no value.

label.description: The new name, when field is label. The app doesn't limit its length, so the limit matches an entry's text block, and a longer value is refused with a sync error rather than cut short.

place.description: The place it belongs to now, when field is place.

activity.description: How the person traveled, when field is activity. The person choosing it confirms the journey's mode.

startsAt.description: The new start time, when field is start.

endsAt.description: The new end time, when field is end.

supersedes.description: Earlier corrections to the same field of the same thing that this one replaces. Only the ones not already replaced by another correction need listing: an older correction stays replaced through the one that replaced it, and corrections are never deleted, so this loses nothing and keeps the list short. Today's corrections list every earlier correction; a device moving them over keeps only the ones no other correction lists.

createdAt.description: When the person made the correction, when known.
